question: The value of 7 {7{} over 15} div {4{} over 9} of left (4{7{} over 10} + 5 {1{} over5}right ) + left ({2{} over 3} - {4{} over 11}right ) is :
solution:
**Given:**

⇒ 7 {7{} over 15} div {4{} over 9} of left (4{7{} over 10} + 5 {1{} over5}right ) + left ({2{} over 3} - {4{} over 11}right )

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7 {7{} over 15} div {4{} over 9} of left (4{7{} over 10} + 5 {1{} over5}right ) + left ({2{} over 3} - {4{} over 11}right )

⇒ 7 {7{} over 15} div {4{} over 9} of left ({47{} over 10} + {26{} over5}right ) + left ({2{} over 3} - {4{} over 11}right )

⇒ {112{} over 15} div {4{} over 9} of left ({47{} over 10} + {26{} over5}right ) + left ({2{} over 3} - {4{} over 11}right )

⇒ (112)/(15) div (4)/(9) times (99)/(10) + (10)/(33)

⇒ (112)/(15) div (22)/(5) + (10)/(33)

⇒ (112)/(15) times (5)/(22) + (10)/(33)

⇒ (56)/(33) + (10)/(33)

⇒ (66)/(33)
